Sandbox_GFL2Exilium_AllowHoldGrant_toolt: When enabled, holding the '+' button on Credits or Outfit Permits in single-player grants test credits or temporary outfit unlocks. Disable for strict survival progression.
Sandbox_GFL2Exilium_FreeUnlockAll_toolti: When enabled, all active characters, outfits, and signature weapons (if enabled) are immediately unlocked in the Ready Room without gacha pulls or purchases.
Sandbox_GFL2Exilium_CreditsPerCash_toolt: How many Ready Room Credits each in-game Money bill exchanges for (default 300, range 10-5000).
Sandbox_GFL2Exilium_AllowSignatureWeapon: When disabled, Ready Room signature weapon pulls and claiming are disabled while keeping all character models and voices. Ideal for melee or custom gun balance servers.
Sandbox_GFL2Exilium_AllowAmmoAndMagazine: When disabled, players cannot buy ammo boxes or claim spare magazines from the Ready Room and must loot them in the world.
